DETAIL: Add sh:class qudt:QuantityValue to the shared diameter and rotational-speed quantity node shapes (or equivalently to every property shape using them). The canonical ranges for propellerDiameter, propellerRotationalSpeedAtMaximumContinuousRatingBollard, lookupInputQuantity, and lookupResultQuantity require QuantityValue nodes; validating only numericValue and unit permits non-QuantityValue resources.
